frame_panel_review_notes: The source main component welds the modeled U-frame and leaf at their contour; reviewed whole-face separation preserves the existing frame, leaf, UVs and materials. The narrow pane and bar are separate components.
license_scope_review_notes: Actual source page and download modal label CC Attribution and link CC BY 4.0.
custom_terms_review_notes: The reviewed page contains only the model name as description; no additional author terms or third-party texture credit are stated.
duplicate_review_notes: New Sketchfab source UID; visible dark metal leaf with narrow vertical window and horizontal push bar differs from the eight accepted models. Local fingerprint also differs.

local_dependency_review_notes: The USDZ packages four 2048 px maps with no external dependency. Its author, CC-BY-4.0 and source URL metadata match the reviewed page; no separate map terms are stated.
local_duplicate_review_notes: Inspect attempt 000002 records fingerprint 73707e2e0e298e0b816b96041e803818f3f9e01dcb7099cd12c5e470b959c738, distinct from all eight accepted source fingerprints. The same author also made the accepted prison door, but these models have different source IDs and geometry.
local_visual_review_notes: Actually viewed both attempt 000004 RTX images: a plain dark face on one side and a textured dark metal face with narrow upper window, horizontal bar, lower kick plate and intact U-frame on the other. No missing part or visible misalignment.
local_mechanical_review_notes: The welded source leaf/frame contour is separated without changing original faces. A 0.4% moving fit provides measured jamb/header clearance; bar, pane, leaf and frame retain collisions. No separate projecting latch or bolt is modeled. Static passes and one isolated RTX 4090 run reaches the geometry-derived 59.8-degree stop with three exact resets, fixed frame and zero reported penetration; robot qualification remains pending.
